The instant when the electric field between the plates is turned off only the gravitational force acts on the oil drop, so it begins to accelerate downwards.

As the speed of the oil drop increases the drag force on the oil drop increases and eventually reaches the same magnitude as the gravitational force. 

The instant this happens, the oil drop reaches terminal speed.
